records.title: last_seen on source_config and chapter_candidates now means last changed
records.body: {"why": "PERF-5 changed-rows-only writes: rewriting every unchanged row only to bump last_seen caused tens of thousands of writes per scan", "impact": "no code decides on these columns; the scan time per source title stays in source_record_scans.checked_at", "0.4.x": "last_seen was the last time the row was listed"}

records.title: Independent audit of phase 2 found 7 issues; 6 fixed, 1 accepted
records.body: {"fixed": ["moved databases stayed in rollback-journal mode: placed files switched back to WAL and every start sets WAL", "move accepted symlinked folders that startup refuses: same check now runs before the move", "new folder had no instance lock until restart: lock taken before copying, kept after success, released on failure", "write nested in a read used a deferred upgrade and left the read writable: IMMEDIATE transaction, write allowed only for the nested call", "status page showed the old database folder after a move: live paths", "storage card hid its instruction text: condition reverted"], "accepted": ["last_seen meaning change (DECISION-20261031-LAST-SEEN-MEANING)"], "open": ["a reverse proxy with a short timeout can cut the move request while the server still switches; the move becomes a queued task in phase 3"]}
